title: Chapter 2945 - 174: Money Rat (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 2945: Chapter 174: Money Rat (Part 2)

Especially those eyes, golden and deep, have lost any human hue.

They looked like those of a deity indifferent to all living beings, and just a glance would inspire fear.

Lugu, in the Late Golden Core Stage, merely felt the pressure redoubled, his heart full of trepidation.

Even Dan Zhu, who once respected Mo Hua, couldn’t help but feel a trace of fear at this moment.

This is the instinctive feeling of living creatures when they face such divine beings.

"Gentleman, are you... alright?"

Dan Zhu’s gaze was heavy, suddenly finding the Mo Hua before him very unfamiliar.

"No worries," Mo Hua spoke, his words indifferent and majestic, nearly devoid of emotion, "The Divine Lord’s grand endeavor is unfinished, the Barbaric Wilderness not yet unified. We must not be lax; advance... to the next Mountain Realm..."

"Yes, Divine Blessing." Lugu cupped his hands and said.

Dan Zhu also glanced at Mo Hua, cupping his hands, "Yes, Gentleman..."

"Go." Mo Hua said.

Lugu and Dan Zhu took one last look at Mo Hua, bowed, and turned to leave.

After the two left, the Big Tiger finally padded forward, step by step coming to Mo Hua’s side, lowering its head to rub against Mo Hua’s shoulder, its large eyes full of concern.

Mo Hua mechanically patted the Big Tiger, following the hints of "Planting Devil in Taoist Heart" within himself, habitually muttering to himself:

"I am..."

"I am..."

His memory seemed stuck; he couldn’t recall his name for quite a while.

Mo Hua’s expression was as calm as water; he pondered for a long time before recalling that somewhat unfamiliar name:

"I am... Mo Hua."

"Mo Hua..."

His words floated softly, seeming as if the name "Mo Hua" was drifting farther and farther away from him.

...

The war of Divine Blessing was still ongoing.

With the Barbarian Soldiers from Vermilion Bird Mountain and the Barbarian Slaves from the Divine Slave Tribe, it swept through the Great Wilderness like fiery fire.

The Divine Lord’s renown continued to spread across the Barbaric Wilderness, as more and more Barbarian Cultivators witnessed the great deeds of Divine Blessing...

Soon, half a month later, another Second Grade Mountain Realm was conquered by the Divine Slave Tribe.

All Barbarian Slaves within the Mountain Realm were liberated.

The renown of the Divine Blessing was further propagated...

But in the largest Witch Priest Hall within the Mountain Realm.

Mo Hua’s cold face showed no sign of joy.

He gazed at his pale hand, and at the deep blue Taotie Pattern that seemed to fade in and out along the Hand Taiyin Lung Meridian, lost in contemplation.

His Lifebound Taotie Formation was not as strong as he had anticipated.

At least, it was far inferior to Sishen.

With the support of the Taotie Formation, Sishen became a living monster, killing relentlessly, until exhausted, then digging out golden cores to eat, finishing, and continuing to kill, eat more, kill again...

Such tirelessness, such ceaselessness, is an eternal "killing machine".

But Mo Hua himself felt none of the sensations of transforming into a "killing machine".

Especially since what he possessed was the "orthodox" twenty-four patterns and Twelve Meridians Taotie Spirit Corpse Formation.

What Lugu had was merely a "test version".

Yet now, contrary to expectations, his felt like the pirated version.

And Lugu, as the "test subject", appeared more like the genuine Taotie Spirit Corpse monster.

"Is it because I’m not dead yet?"

"Would I, like Sishen, become stronger if I were dead?"

"Or is it because this body of mine is simply too weak to realize the true might of the Taotie Spirit Corpse Formation?"

"Or perhaps... this Spiritual Corpse Formation is not yet fully nourished?"

Mo Hua frowned slightly.

This Spiritual Corpse Formation indeed had not finished nurturing.

Not to mention being fully nurtured, it might not have even been "started" yet.

The Taotie Spirit Corpse Formation, bearing the name "Taotie", naturally required immense power to support its operation.

And this power source is very simple, with no alternatives; only Spirit Stones.

Yet the quantity of Spirit Stones required was unimaginably vast.

During this period, Mo Hua continuously refined Spirit Stones, absorbing Spiritual Power, infusing it into his Taotie Spiritual Remains.

But it only went in, never came out, without end.

It was as if he were throwing Spirit Stones into a bottomless abyss, with no knowledge of how long it would take to fill.

In the Qian Learning State Boundary, Mo Hua never lacked Spirit Stones, because he had the backing of the Sect, abundant resources, Aunt Wan, and Master Gu from the Gu Family Refinery Shop, who would often send him some "dividends".

Some elders, in order to strengthen their relationship with this formation genius, would also give him gifts from time to time.

Mo Hua was quite well-off.

In the Great Wilderness, he was first a Shaman, and now even a Divine Priest, equally not lacking Spirit Stones.

Moreover, he came from a poor Loose Cultivator background, and was very thrifty, never spending a single Spirit Stone unnecessarily.

Therefore, Mo Hua had long not experienced the feeling of lacking Spirit Stones.

But now, the "well-off" Mo Hua looked at his Taotie Spirit Bones, and felt very uncertain.

He vaguely felt that the Spirit Stones he had saved over the years by "being frugal" would now all be thrown into this bottomless "black pit".

He had no idea how many Spirit Stones he would have to "feed" to truly "satiate" this Twelve Scripture Gluttonous Spirit Corpse Formation.

His Heaven Yan Jue was the bottomless pit of Divine Sense.

His lifebound formation was the bottomless pit of Spirit Stones.

Even the "divine" version of Mo Hua, with cold emotions, indifferent to common matters, could not help but take a deep breath and frown when thinking of these two "bottomless pits".

But this matter was unavoidable.

This was the Lifebound Formation, his own Magical Treasure.

No matter how many Spirit Stones it takes, the Twelve Scripture Gluttonous Spirit Corpse Formation must be filled.

Mo Hua now only hopes that after he expends great effort to "feed" this Taotie Spirit Corpse Formation, his lifebound formation can unleash the true Taotie might, and not disappoint him.

Thinking of this, a feeling of "spiritual hunger" suddenly arose.

Mo Hua subconsciously stuffed another Spirit Stone into his mouth, chewed on it with an empty mouth, and then swallowed it.

This was the "bad habit" he developed after refining the Taotie Spirit Corpse Formation:

Eating Spirit Stones.

Even though it would be more "proper" to crush the Spirit Stones like ordinary cultivators, turning it into Spiritual Energy, absorbing it through the strange points and acupoints around his body.

But Mo Hua could not help it.

His skeleton was inscribed with the Taotie Absolute Array, which to some extent, also meant that the "Laws" of Taotie were integrated into his flesh, making him instinctively closer to Taotie, so when he lacked something or craved something, he instinctively wanted to "eat" it in the most primitive way.

Right now Mo Hua lacked Spirit Stones, so he couldn’t help but eat them.

He ate Spirit Stones like he was eating "snacks".

Directly chewing with his mouth, swallowing, then using his meridians and internal organs to digest, channeling the Spiritual Power through the Twelve Regular Meridians, into his bones.

For cultivators, eating Spirit Stones with an empty mouth is definitely a "quirk".

But Mo Hua, now full of divinity, didn’t care if he was still human or not, let alone the customs of cultivators.

He acted according to the instincts of deities, that is, the "Laws" within his body.

The laws told him to eat, so he ate.

If he didn’t eat, his whole body would feel uncomfortable, and so would his divinity.

Mo Hua, just like this, sat in the high position of Divine Blessing, like a blood and flesh puppet of a deity, munching on Spirit Stones with an expressionless face, while contemplating how to "eat" more Spirit Stones to fill his Twelve Scripture Gluttonous Spirit Corpse Formation.

The Spirit Stones of the various tribes of the Great Wilderness, he could certainly "sweep" them all up to fulfill his personal needs, nourishing his Lifebound Formation.

But the Great Wilderness was already a place scarce in Spirit Stones.

These precious Spirit Stone resources were also needed to build the Thick Earth Formation, to improve the living standards of the Great Wilderness.

They also needed to be used to promote the Divine War, and to unite the Barbaric Wilderness.

Spirit Stones were resources for livelihood and war, Mo Hua could not misappropriate them, otherwise, it would affect the overall situation.

Since that’s the case, he could only seek Spirit Stones elsewhere...

As he ate Spirit Stones, Mo Hua suddenly had a moment of clarity, his gaze became focused.

"The Hua family..."

The Hua family was a great family in Taoist State, with deep roots, making a "war fortune" in the Great Wilderness, profiteering with Fasting Pills, a "greasy fat sheep".

If he were to slaughter this big fat sheep...

Mo Hua, akin to a deity, coldly licked the Spirit Stone fragments at the corner of his mouth.

...

Three thousand Barbaric Wilderness.

The end land encircled by famine disaster.

Within a certain Third Grade Mountain Realm, outside the rule of the Divine Blessing forces.

In a secret room, dim lights flickered.

A middle-aged, slightly overweight Late Golden Core Stage cultivator was staring at the broken golden jade mouse sculpture on the ground, frowning tightly.

"Even the old ancestor’s methods are not working..."

"This so-called ’Divine Blessing’ is actually so powerful? What is his... background..."

Elder You, who originally had a gentle demeanor and upheld harmony brings wealth, now had a stern and extremely ugly expression.
